_comment: Instruction variants for SmolVLA prompt augmentation. 'train' is sampled per training sample; 'test' is held out (never seen in training) and used only for evaluation. p_empty: fraction of training samples that get an empty instruction.
train: Push the T-shaped block onto the T-shaped target.
Push the T block onto the target.
Move the T-shaped piece so it lines up with the target outline.
Slide the T onto the T-shaped goal area.
Align the T-shaped block with the target shape.
Get the T block to cover the target T.
Use the agent to push the T into its target pose.
Place the T-shaped object exactly on the marked T.
Nudge the block until it matches the T-shaped target.
Push the block so that it sits on top of the target.
test: Move the T block so that it covers the green T.
Position the T-shaped block over the goal.
Drive the T into the outlined target region.
Bring the block onto the T-shaped mark.
